name: Space quotes
note: Real scientists' and astronauts' words for held screens, each with who said it (PC7, postcards design; Alex accepted 25 Nov: scientists and astronauts in the base app, film, song, game and fiction quotes in the free fan pack). From SSE3's space-quotes.txt. A source is given only where it is sure; a quote known only by attribution says so.

notes.text: The cosmos is within us. We are made of star-stuff. We are a way for the universe to know itself.
Look up at the stars and not down at your feet.
The universe is under no obligation to make sense to you.
Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
The Earth is the cradle of humanity, but mankind cannot stay in the cradle forever.
To confine our attention to terrestrial matters would be to limit the human spirit.
Equipped with his five senses, man explores the universe around him and calls the adventure Science.
The universe seems neither benign nor hostile, merely indifferent.
The history of astronomy is a history of receding horizons.
For small creatures such as we the vastness is bearable only through love.
There are as many atoms in a single molecule of your DNA as there are stars in the typical galaxy. We are, each of us, a little universe.
If aliens visit us, the outcome would be much as when Columbus landed in America, which didn't turn out well for the Native Americans.
That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
I see Earth! It is so beautiful.
Magnificent desolation.
The stars don't look bigger, but they do look brighter.
I am alone now, truly alone, and absolutely isolated from any known life. I am it.

If somebody'd said before the flight, 'Are you going to get carried away looking at the earth from the moon?' I would have said, 'No, no way.' But yet when I first looked back at the earth, standing on the moon, I cried.

It suddenly struck me that that tiny pea, pretty and blue, was the Earth. I put up my thumb and shut one eye, and my thumb blotted out the planet Earth. I didn't feel like a giant. I felt very, very small.
Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed.
Here men from the planet Earth first set foot upon the Moon... We came in peace for all mankind.
